newsitem.title: USA: Mattel takes $8 mln charge for dolls.
newsitem.headline: Mattel takes $8 mln charge for dolls.

text.p: Mattel Inc said it took an $8 million charge to after-tax earnings in the fourth quarter due relating to its Cabbage Patch Kids Snacktime Kids dolls, which were pulled from the market after several children got hair and hands stuck in the dolls' mouths.
Mattel, which also offered $40 refund to owners of the dolls, cited a negative impact of $10 million to sales.

Additionally, Mattel took an after-tax charge of $15.1 million following talks with the Securities and Exchange Commission relating to its accounting for certain royalties and participation fees related to prior periods.
